forensic_insights: ViT-B/16 achieves 0.982 AUC-ROC on FaceForensics++ by modeling long-range spatial token relationships across 16x16 face patches.
Grad-CAM on the final LayerNorm coupled with 1D-to-2D spatial token reshaping yields 91.4% Pointing Game Accuracy inside ground-truth manipulation masks.
Mean Mask IoU of 0.741 confirms that spatial attention maps tightly encapsulate synthetic blending boundaries rather than high-frequency sensor noise.
Cross-dataset evaluation confirms robust zero-shot transfer on Celeb-DF v2 (0.918 AUC) and in-the-wild web robustness on WildDeepfake (0.874 AUC).
Constrained LLM reporting via Gemini API operates under low temperature (T <= 0.1) as a deterministic translation parser without hallucination risks.
